facts.raw_span: A 52-year-old woman
well-controlled HIV (viral load <40 copies/mL, CD4 count 290 cells/mm3)
20% weight loss (12 kg) over one year
no fevers, night sweats, gastrointestinal symptoms, or gynecological complaints
a palpable mass in the right iliac fossa
a drop in hemoglobin from 13 g/dL to 10 g/dL
a lactate dehydrogenase level of 643 U/L
a C-reactive protein level of 80 mg/L
a normal white-cell count
a 15 cm mass possibly arising from the vaginal wall with a potential fistulous connection to the cecum
mesenteric lymph nodes measuring up to 27 mm but no distant metastases
Serum tumor markers (CA19-9, CEA, CA125) were all negative
